{{Top}}
[[File:OssusTemple.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The terraformed planet Ossus]]
'''Terraforming''', '''terraformation''', '''vongforming''' or '''xenoforming''' was the process of changing a previously uninhabitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or [[Moon/Legends|moon]] into a habitable one for a certain number of [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the rule of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] became the first known culture to develop terraforming machinery and technology, and used it upon planets such as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. At an unknown point prior to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] creation, the desert planet of [[Bar Neth]] was terraformed from an inhabitable desert.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

Terraforming could be a lucrative, albeit longterm, investment for corporations.<ref name="CORPORATE">[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]</ref> The Hutts invested heavily in the [[Kor Gorensla system]], terraforming over fifteen planets and moons in the system.<ref name="LORDS">[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Ionic Ring Ship]] was developed as a [[Weather control/Legends|weather control]] and terraforming [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], effectively causing the [[devastation of Rion]].<ref name="STKR">"[[The Second Kessel Run]]"</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[25 ABY/Legends|25]]&ndash;[[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]], the extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] terraformed many subject worlds to better suit them. The Yuuzhan Vong phrase was known as '''worldshaping''', but others referred to it as '''Vongforming''' or '''Vongformation''' which was performed by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] called [[Shaper caste|shapers]]. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], and [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] were examples of terraformed planets. Even a century later, reconstruction of many Vongformed planets still wasn't completed, partially due to sabotage.
